title: Book Ramsey numbers via algebraic constructions
summary: Let \(B_n\) denote the book graph consisting of \(n\) triangles sharing a common edge. Rousseau and Sheehan (1978) proved, using Paley graphs, that \(R(B_n,B_n)=4n+2\) whenever \(4n+1\) is a prime power. Since then, only a few additional exact values of \(R(B_n,B_n)\) have been obtained. In this paper, we obtain \(R(B_n,B_n)=4n+1\) for infinitely many \(n\) by constructing graphs from pseudo-cyclic strongly regular graphs (PC-graphs).
